name: Surrogate Gradient for Discrete Material Assignment
aliases: Inverse Rendering for Discrete X-Ray CT
definition: Reconstruction of discrete material assignments $X_i \in \{1, \dots, m\}$ for voxels $i$ using the Beer-Lambert law for absorptive X-rays without scattering.
summary: Surrogate Gradient for Discrete Material Assignment reconstructs discrete voxel materials by minimizing reconstruction error via differentiable volume rendering, distinguished by its two-pass DDA traversal that efficiently computes surrogate gradients without retracing rays.
